title: Curfew After They Start Driving: Build a Trust Ladder, Not One Permanent Rule
summary: Separate the driving cut-off from the home time, set a lawful safety floor, and give a newly licensed teen a visible path toward more driving freedom.
seo_title: Teen Driving Curfew: Build a Trust Ladder
seo_description: Set a teen driving curfew using two clocks, a lawful safety floor, safe-exit scripts, and a reviewable trust ladder for more independence.
release_move: Keep law, vehicle access, and immediate safety with the parent while gradually transferring trip proposals, parked updates, safe non-driving decisions, and review evidence to the teen.

core_belief_shift.from: A strict permanent driving curfew proves I am protecting my teen, while a later one proves I trust them.
core_belief_shift.to: Law and safety set the floor; trust appears in a clear, evidence-based review path that expands one driving condition at a time.

book_relevance.reason: The War Playbook is a soft teen-facing fit for reading conditions, staying composed when plans change, choosing a safe retreat, and accepting clean consequences; it is not driver training or legal guidance.

hero.alt: A concerned mother calmly discusses an evening driving plan with her teenage son as he holds car keys beside the family car at dusk.

social_image.alt: A concerned mother calmly discusses an evening driving plan with her teenage son as he holds car keys beside the family car at dusk.
